classLabels.measured: Published specification of a shipping or deployed switch

title: 1,000x faster than MEMS; about 300x faster than the nearest merchant rival
subtitle: Dipole is a different class of mark on purpose. A hollow circle is a target; a filled one is a published specification.

rows.label: Commercial OCS, typical
rows.detail: Google states commercial OCS switching times are typically 10 to 20 ms.

rows.label: Dipole Labs
rows.detail: Sub-microsecond, per the YC company page. No bench result published.

caption: Against the mechanical switches that dominate deployments, a sub-microsecond target is a jump of four to five orders of magnitude. Against Salience, which already ships below 300 µs, the gap is closer to 300x. The memo's competition section now says so.
source: Polatis datasheet; Google, Mission Apollo, August 2022; Salience Labs product launch, March 10, 2026; Y Combinator company page.
